stories.summary: The Royal Navy's HMS Vengeance nuclear submarine has set a new record by completing a 217-day mission. For about seven months, the crew had almost no contact with the outside world.

stories.title: Japan: The dark secret behind an island paradise full of rabbits
stories.summary: Hundreds of rabbits roam freely on Japan's Okunoshima Island, delighting visitors from around the world. But behind its idyllic scenery lies a troubling history of secret chemical weapons production.

stories.title: Video shows isolated Awá Indigenous people make contact with government team in Brazil
stories.summary: Around 20 members of Brazil’s isolated Awá Indigenous group have approached a government outpost in the Amazon, asking for yams before returning to the forest. The rare encounter has raised concerns about their health and possible food shortages.

stories.title: Fiona the hippo dies after swallowing a visitor's hat
stories.summary: Fiona, the Cincinnati Zoo's much-loved hippopotamus, has died after swallowing a knitted hat that became stuck in her digestive system. Vets made several attempts to remove the object but were unable to save the nine-year-old animal.

stories.title: Bhutan: Traditional wood painting shapes the kingdom's architecture
stories.summary: In Bhutan, artisans hand-paint intricate patterns on wooden buildings, preserving a centuries-old tradition. Known as Shing Tshon, the craft remains central to the kingdom's cultural identity.

stories.title: Moving my religion: Vatican Museums explore a century of Popemobiles
stories.summary: From Pius XI's Mercedes to John Paul II's Popemobile: eight historic cars show how Popes' vehicles have changed. The Vatican Museums exhibition retraces a century of history, between technology, curiosities and safety.

stories.title: Vatican: Giant Christmas tree lifted into place beside St Peter's Basilica
stories.summary: A towering 25-metre Christmas tree was lifted into place in St Peter's Square, Vatican City, on Friday 20 November 2026, as preparations began for this year's Christmas celebrations. The silver fir, donated by a community in southern Italy, will be unveiled on 7 December.

stories.title: UK anthem returns to the EU stage in symbolic post-Brexit moment
stories.summary: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham was welcomed by EU leaders in Brussels for a summit aimed at strengthening post-Brexit relations. God Save the King rang out for the first time since Brexit at the UK–EU summit.

stories.title: Himalaya-sized ancient 'supermountains' found beneath Antarctica's ice sheet
stories.summary: The discovery offers a window into the continent's geological past and of how life on Earth has evolved.

stories.title: NYC mayor unveils plan to close notorious Rikers Island jail by 2032
stories.summary: Rikers had been slated to close by August 2027 following legislation passed by the City Council in 2019. Moving the deadline will require a change to this law.

stories.title: Turkey: Activists chant 'shame' as COP31 negotiations falter
stories.summary: Climate activists denounced the proposed outcome of COP31 in Antalya, Turkey, on Friday 20 November 2026, accusing governments of failing to deliver meaningful progress on tackling climate change. They chanted "shame" as negotiations approached their deadline.

stories.title: Cost of living protests sweep across Europe
stories.summary: Thousands marched across European cities on Friday to protest against the cost of living and other issues.

stories.title: Miami or Vice City? Tour the real-world inspiration for GTA 6
stories.summary: BBC News Mundo’s Rafael Rojas visits the real-life Miami locations that inspired Vice City, GTA 6’s fictionalised setting.
